messages.content: What does high LDL mean?

LDL is often called "bad cholesterol" because high levels can build up in blood vessel walls. Lowering it usually involves less fried food, more fiber, and regular exercise. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
Is 130/85 blood pressure bad?

130/85 mmHg is slightly above the ideal range (below 120/80) but not an emergency. Doctors usually suggest reducing salt, managing stress, and re-checking regularly. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
What is HbA1c?

HbA1c shows your average blood sugar over the last 2-3 months. Below 5.7 percent is normal, 5.7-6.4 is prediabetes, and 6.5 or higher suggests diabetes. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
Should I worry about triglycerides of 180?

180 mg/dL is mildly elevated (ideal is below 150). Cutting sugary drinks and alcohol, plus more activity, often helps. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
What does fasting glucose 102 mean?

102 mg/dL is just above the normal fasting range (70-99) and falls in the early prediabetes zone. Lifestyle changes can often bring it back down. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
Can prediabetes be reversed?

Often yes. Weight loss of 5-7 percent, 150 minutes of weekly exercise, and fewer refined carbs significantly lower the risk of progressing to diabetes. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
What is a normal HDL level?

HDL is "good cholesterol" - higher is better. Above 40 mg/dL for men and above 50 for women is the usual target. Exercise tends to raise it. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
Why avoid grapefruit with amlodipine?

Grapefruit can slow the breakdown of amlodipine in your body, making its effects and side effects stronger. It is safest to avoid it. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
What are common amlodipine side effects?

The most common ones are ankle swelling, facial flushing, and dizziness. Tell your doctor if they bother you - the dose can often be adjusted. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
When is the MR booster given?

The measles-rubella booster is typically given at 18 months and again around school entry at age 6, depending on national schedules. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
Is a BMI of 27 overweight?

Yes, 25-29.9 is classified as overweight. Even losing 4-5 kg can meaningfully improve blood sugar and blood pressure. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
How much exercise lowers blood sugar?

About 150 minutes per week of moderate activity, like brisk walking 30 minutes five times a week, is the standard recommendation. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
What is metformin for?

Metformin lowers blood sugar and is usually the first medication considered when lifestyle changes are not enough for type 2 diabetes. This is general education, not a diagnosis - please discuss your results with a doctor.
